1606d8.zh: 游戏没有切换难度（%s）——见日志

160750.zh: 无法设置步数（没有正在进行的游戏？）

160798.zh: 敌人的时钟落后 %.1f 秒且无法调整（旧版本写入的存档）：已修正，游戏时间保持不变

1800d0.en: - the game was asked to unlock its Steam achievement
1800d0.zh: ——已请求游戏解锁对应的 Steam 成就

180108.en: - its Steam achievement could not be asked for (see the log)
180108.zh: ——无法请求其 Steam 成就（见日志）

1802e8.en: - held off by the mod: its scenario stays cleared, so No Way Out stays open
1802e8.zh: ——由本 mod 保持关闭：其剧本仍保持通关，因此「无路可逃」继续开放

180338.en: "%s" cannot be switched off in this build - see the log.
180338.zh: 「%s」在此版本中无法关闭——见日志。

181300.en: the game's records were not found in this build - see the log
181300.zh: 此版本中未找到游戏的记录——见日志

1813e0.en: No Way Out is not open with this save - it can be earned again by play
1813e0.zh: 该存档下「无路可逃」尚未开放——可通过游玩重新取得

181508.en: The records are only switched while their records screen is open.
181508.zh: 只有在对应的记录界面打开时才能切换记录。

181550.en: The records could not be read - nothing was changed.
181550.zh: 无法读取记录——未做任何更改。

1815a0.en: The Ghost Survivors' records could not be read - nothing was changed.
1815a0.zh: 无法读取幽灵生还者的记录——未做任何更改。

1817a8.en: The records could not be read - see the log.

181980.en: The game gives this one back by itself whenever every other listed record is complete (the next time the records screen opens).
181980.zh: 只要列表中其它记录全部完成，游戏会在下次打开记录界面时自动把这一项交还给你。

181a00.en: Switching it off makes enough Mr. Raccoons count as unbroken again that it cannot come back by itself (the game recounts them at every clear): break them again to earn it back.
181a00.zh: 关闭它会让足够多的浣熊先生重新计为未破坏，因此它无法自行恢复（游戏每次通关都会重新统计）：再次破坏它们即可重新取得。

181ab8.en: Switching it off makes one safe or lock you opened count as unopened again (the game recounts them at every one opened): open it again to earn this back.
181ab8.zh: 关闭它会让一个你已开启的保险箱或锁重新计为未开启（游戏每开启一个都会重新统计）：再次开启即可重新取得。

181bc8.en: The Ghost Survivors' records could not be read - see the log.
181bc8.zh: 无法读取幽灵生还者的记录——见日志。

181da8.en: Held off by the mod: the scenario stays cleared, so No Way Out stays open. Clearing the scenario again does not bring it back - switch it on here.
181da8.zh: 由本 mod 保持关闭：剧本仍保持通关，因此「无路可逃」继续开放。再次通关该剧本不会让它恢复——请在此处开启。

181e40.en: No Way Out opens once Forgotten Soldier, Runaway and No Time To Mourn are all cleared. While it is open, switching this off holds it off instead of un-clearing the scenario, so nothing is locked away.
181e40.zh: 「无路可逃」需要在「被遗忘的士兵」「逃亡者」「来不及哀悼」全部通关后才会开放。在它开放期间关闭本项，会改为由 mod 保持其关闭状态，而不是取消剧本通关，因此不会有任何内容被锁死。

181f10.en: Switching it off keeps the scenario cleared - as a training clear - so No Way Out stays open. Clearing it without training mode earns it again.
181f10.zh: 关闭它会让该剧本保持通关状态（作为训练通关），因此「无路可逃」继续开放。以非训练模式通关即可重新取得。

181fa0.en: Switching it off makes one Mr. Raccoon count as unbroken again: break it again to earn this back.
181fa0.zh: 关闭它会让一只浣熊先生重新计为未破坏：再次破坏即可重新取得。

182008.en: Switching it off puts the play count just under the goal: the next game you play earns it again.
182008.zh: 关闭它会让游玩次数退到距目标一步之遥：再玩一次即可重新取得。

182070.en: Switching it off forgets both routes: take both again to earn it.
182070.zh: 关闭它会遗忘两条路线：重新走完两条路线即可取得。

184ce9.en: it was put back as it was

184d08.en: it could not be put back; check the saves in the game
184d08.zh: 无法放回；请检查游戏中的存档

184d60.en: Steam's remote storage is not available - nothing was changed.
184d60.zh: Steam 的远程存储不可用——未做任何更改。

184dc0.en: Steam's save files are not laid out as the game's (see the log) - nothing was changed.
184dc0.zh: Steam 的存档文件布局与游戏不一致（见日志）——未做任何更改。

184e90.en: Steam's save files do not match the game's list (slot %d) - nothing was changed.
184e90.zh: Steam 的存档文件与游戏的列表不符（槽位 %d）——未做任何更改。

184ee8.en: %s could not be read from Steam (%s) - nothing was changed.
184ee8.zh: 无法从 Steam 读取 %s（%s）——未做任何更改。

184f78.zh: Steam 拒绝写入 %s（%s）——未做任何更改。
